parties.respondent: The State Of Andhra Pradesh & Anr.

summary: Criminal proceedings against former Chief Minister for alleged siphoning of Rs.370 crores in skill development project; allegations under IPC Sections 166, 167, 409, 418, 420 etc. and Prevention of Corruption Act Sections 12, 13; non-compliance with Section 17A (prior approval requirement) argued; accused added via memo after initial FIR; quashing petition dismissed by HC; standard of scrutiny in preliminary inquiry; leave granted to challenge HC order.
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 s.12, s.13(2), s.13(1)(c), s.13(1)(d), s.17A
final_judgment: Leave granted; matter remitted to High Court for reconsideration with direction to decide within two weeks.
